compliance_risks.could_misstate: Classifying any product from its name. Doing so produces errors in both directions - calling insurance a membership, and calling a service a discount.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never type or describe a product from its name. Read the Info page.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing client-facing. This is an internal rule.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Product names in this portfolio are unreliable indicators of product type IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. 'AWA SimpleShield Membership Plan' is fixed indemnity insurance. 'Prime Health Pass Discount' is described on its own page as a Diagnostic Services Product delivering services. Between April and September NEO inserted the word 'Membership' into four Safe Guard product names without any evident change of type. Meanwhile 'AssistPro Discount' genuinely is a discount program.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before any add-on is described on a call, and before any tooling assigns it a category.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Anything at all beyond the dollar figures. In particular, describing the plan as covering a condition, or answering 'is my pre-existing condition covered' - there is no source for either answer.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not say what the plan is (major medical, STM, limited medical, indemnity) - the source does not say. Do not say a service is 'not covered' because the schedule shows a dash; a dash means the schedule prints no value. Do not answer any pre-existing or waiting-period question.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: This plan pays set dollar amounts per day for specific services, up to a set number of days. It is not major medical. I will send you the brochure and go through the exclusions with you before we go any further.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The only source available to an agent for these eight live products is a per-day dollar schedule on the FirstEnroll Info page. It states no product type, no exclusions, no waiting periods, no pre-existing provision, no eligibility rule and no definitions. The TERMS panel is empty.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: AFSLIC20_AWP_Brochure_rev1.pdf is linked on the storefront and has not been read. Read it before selling.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Nothing directly - this is a defect in the document, not in what the agent says. But it means the clause telling the client who to contact about claims may be unreadable, and the client may later say they were never told who their agent was.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client the agreement names their agent.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Give the client your own name, agency and email verbally on the recorded call, and confirm you are their contact for benefit and claims questions. Do not rely on the agreement to have done it.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The FirstEnroll enrollment-agreement template served on the live storefront contains unrendered variables - $parentcompany, $product_label, $agent_fullname, $agent_Email, $parentemail - confirmed on two unrelated product families (American Financial Critical Illness page 38175, and Health Choice Silver page 32339). The affected clauses are the third-party administrator disclaimer, the Plan and Claims Inquiries clause and the Writing Agent Contact block.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Raise with FirstEnroll whether the executed enrollment document renders these variables. See G-039.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Explaining to a client why one of these costs more than another, or recommending an upgrade from Harmony Care to Harmony Care PLUS on the basis of better benefits. No benefit difference is published anywhere.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not describe Harmony Care PLUS as having more benefits than Harmony Care. Do not describe any tier of one family as better than the same tier of another. Do not quote a Harmony Care benefit from the PLUS brochure.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: State the schedule for the specific plan and tier in front of you and nothing more. If a client asks what the difference is between these families, say you will find out - do not improvise one.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Thirty-three live variants across four differently-named families publish one identical benefit set, tier for tier, and one identical 20-state availability list. Harmony Care and Harmony Care PLUS additionally share a single brochure titled for the PLUS product.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: See C-022 and C-023. This needs an answer from FirstEnroll before any comparative statement is made.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: For any product in this group, do not answer a coverage, exclusion, waiting-period or pre-existing question on a recorded call from portal material alone. Obtain the carrier document first.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: 51 of the 80 products on the NEO agent storefront have no brochure, certificate or policy document attached anywhere in the enrolment system. For those products the NEO reference page is the only available source, and four of those pages carry a limitations or exclusions heading with no text beneath it.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never read the GapAfford bullet list as describing the insurance. If a client asks about pre-existing conditions the answer is the 12-month exclusion, full stop.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The GapAfford Plus page lists 'no pre-existing condition limitations' among the features of the DISCOUNT programme. The insurance itself excludes pre-existing conditions for a continuous 12 months from the effective date.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: State the 30-day sickness wait AND the 12-month pre-existing exclusion together. They are separate provisions and both bite.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: A 30-day waiting period applies to Sickness from the Coverage Effective Date. Sickness is defined to include illness, infection, disease, Complication of Pregnancy and any other abnormal physical condition not caused by an Accident. Injury is not subject to it.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: In those eight states the discount layer delivers nothing. Do not present it as part of the value in a client's state without checking.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: GapAfford Plus is unavailable in Alaska, Connecticut, Delaware, Montana, Rhode Island, Utah, Vermont and Washington, and the member must pay providers at the time of service.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Disclose before close, and quote the specific per-day cap for the benefit being discussed rather than describing the plan as covering hospitalisation.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The product is Limited Benefit Health Insurance. The NCE page states a Limited Benefit Medical plan is not comprehensive major medical, is not intended to replace one, and is capped at specific amounts for specific services.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Until the PDFs are filed, any compliance challenge to a benefit statement on these products can be answered only with the ledger's citations, not with the underlying document. Treat filing them as outstanding remediation, not housekeeping.

exclusion.cosmetic.v: Cosmetic surgery, except that cosmetic surgery shall not include reconstructive surgery when such service is incidental to or follows surgery resulting from trauma, infection or other disease of the involved part, and reconstructive surgery because of congenital disease or anomaly of a covered Dependent Child which has resulted in a functional defect

exclusion.dental.v: Dental care or treatment except for such care or treatment due to accidental injury to sound natural teeth within 12 months of the accident, and except for dental care or treatment necessary due to congenital disease or anomaly. Sound Natural Teeth means teeth that are free of active or chronic clinical decay, have at least 50% bone support and are functional in the arch

exclusion.general.v: No benefit for items listed regardless of Medical Necessity or a health care provider's recommendation. No benefit for treatment, services or supplies which are not Medically Necessary; are not prescribed by a Doctor as necessary to treat Sickness or injury; are experimental or investigational in nature, except as required by law; are received without charge or legal obligation to pay; or are provided by an immediate family member

exclusion.other.v: Felony or illegal occupation; manipulations of the musculoskeletal system; suicide or injuries which any covered person intentionally does to himself, whether sane or insane; war or act of war, riot, insurrection, service in the armed forces; work-related injury or sickness where benefits are payable under any state or federal Workers' Compensation, employer's liability or occupational disease law; pregnancy; voluntary abortion except where the covered person has a life-threatening condition

fees.association_enrollment.v: The rates do not include an association one-time, non-refundable enrollment fee, which is processed at the time of enrollment on the day of enrollment; the initial premium draft is inclusive of that fee; future drafts occur once a month, approximately every 30 days
